honest_tension_declared.statement: The campaign prompt section 6 requires 'an after-measurement that differs from the before in the predicted direction'. For A2 the PRODUCTION figure cannot differ, and must not be made to.
honest_tension_declared.why: A2 is a prospective code-path fix. The 301 historical empty-error records stay 301 forever. Backfilling error text onto past failures would mean INVENTING a cause the engine never recorded - precisely the defect CLAUDE.md N.7 item 6 forbids ('an honest null beats an invented judgment') and B.10 forbids ('no fabricated computation').
honest_tension_declared.resolution: The after-metric is measured on the CODE, not on the history: the number of engine paths that CAN terminate a run-asset in a failed state without writing attributable text. That figure is real, re-runnable, and moved in the predicted direction. The historical figure is reported unchanged and explicitly labelled as such.

primary_after_figure.metric: production TypeScript UPDATE sites that set build_run_assets to a failed state (aborted/error) WITHOUT binding error text
primary_after_figure.population: all UPDATE build_run_assets statements in platform/src, excluding __tests__
primary_after_figure.verification_detail: 5 failed-state update sites remain in production TS (watchdog/route.ts:161, :168, :387, :448 and terminalizeFailedRun.ts:54). All 5 carry 'error = $1'. The only site without an error clause is watchdog/route.ts:294, which sets state='complete' - a success path, correctly carrying no error.

historical_figure_unchanged_by_design.metric: empty-error share of historical failure records
historical_figure_unchanged_by_design.query: SELECT state, count(*) FILTER (WHERE error IS NULL OR btrim(error)='') AS empty_error, count(*) AS total FROM build_run_assets WHERE state IN ('error','aborted') GROUP BY state;
historical_figure_unchanged_by_design.note: UNCHANGED AND CORRECTLY SO. Reported here so no reader mistakes the code fix for a historical repair.

corroborating_figure.metric: rows ever written by the deleted M-5 backstop
corroborating_figure.query: SELECT count(*) FROM build_run_assets WHERE error LIKE 'orphan-watchdog%'
corroborating_figure.note: M-5 never changed state, so any row it had ever written would still carry its text. Zero rows means it never fired once in its life - which is what made deleting it safe rather than a loss of coverage. Measured by the reviewer, independently of the implementer.

seeded_failure_proof.method: one real failure seeded at each identified path against a throwaway local database, then the deleted M-5 block temporarily re-inserted to confirm the new tests fail on the real text
seeded_failure_proof.with_defect_reintroduced: 2 failed / 5 passed, both failures asserting on the actual message text
seeded_failure_proof.note: The first pass's proof failed on undefined imports rather than on the defect - the right conclusion for the wrong reason. This one fails for the reason it claims.

finding_registered_not_fixed.statement: watchdog/route.ts:294 sets state='complete' without clearing a pre-existing error. A row that errored and later completed retains stale error text.
finding_registered_not_fixed.severity: latent - with M-5 deleted, nothing stamps a healthy asset, so no current path produces the contradictory pair
